title: My Trading Bot Passed a $100K Prop Firm Challenge... Then I Blew It
author: Suthekingg
selftext:
Strategy 1 (NASDAQ intraday) on demo: 29 trades, PF 1.79, +$11,394 (Aug 24 – Oct 29).

Phase 1 of a $100K prop eval: passed in 5 weeks, $100K → $108,093. Honestly, part of that was a lucky stretch; over years of data the strategy is a lot flatter.

Phase 2: I got overconfident and added strategies that looked great in backtests. One looked better than strategy 1, until I found bugs in my backtest. That one alone lost $4,175; the add-ons together −$6,600. Strategy 1 itself was still +$602.

Now the damaged $100K account (at $93.7K) is a live stress test for a team of tested (most are still in testing phase) strategies, plus a fresh $100K running only strategy 1. Will keep updating
